info.title: Codoxear Computer HTTP relay allowlist
info.description: The namespace preserves Computer-local session IDs. Browser /workspace/api routes instead use published agent IDs and map them after account authorization. Only the listed method/path combinations are relayed. Files require a separate current workspace grant; optional Git, uploads and transcoding require explicit capability flags. Policy, identity, binding and grant revision are rechecked during streams.
